issue_request: FHIR-6982 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Observation change request from the 2015 May ballot reporting that http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geneticsAssessedCondition was a broken link from the old Observation genetics profile page. The resolution says the link was fixed.
initial_application: No FHIR-6982-tagged source commit was found. Historical release artifacts show the old DSTU2-era StructureDefinition/geneticsAssessedCondition definition existed; later source history used the renamed DiagnosticReport-geneticsAssessedCondition canonical, repaired related genetics profile extension expressions, and then removed outdated core genomics profiles, extensions, and examples.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini has active Observation and DiagnosticReport resources but no active genetics profile entry. Current core source has no non-history reference to geneticsAssessedCondition, DiagnosticReport-geneticsAssessedCondition, or the old observation-genetics-cg-prf-1a page. Current Observation and DiagnosticReport narrative points to the Genomics Reporting IG and GenomicStudy. The FHIR Extension Pack contains DiagnosticReport-geneticsAssessedCondition as retired/deprecated with replacement guidance to the Genomics Reporting Guide.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. The old broken link is outside the current core build, and editing core would not affect an active artifact.
